description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，保证在不同请求间唯一，大小写敏感、不超过 64 个 ASCII 字符。
description.en: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. The client generates this value. It must be unique among different requests. The token is case-sensitive and can contain up to 64 ASCII characters.

description.zh:
集群名称，集群名称需满足如下要求：

- 不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。
- 长度为 2~256 个字符。
description.en:
The cluster name. The cluster name must meet the following requirements:

- It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

- It must be 2 to 256 characters in length.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb modify-db-cluster-description-zonal --db-cluster-id pc-00000000000000 --db-cluster-description pc-0000000000000000 --client-token 6000170000591aed949d0f54a343f1a4233c1e7d1c5c000000 --region cn-hangzhou
